facebook.content:
Beloved, the Lord’s promise stands firm: “My grace is sufficient, and His power is made perfect in our weakness” (2 Cor 12:9). When the night feels endless, remember He is the sunrise you cannot miss. Walk today in that confidence, knowing every trial refines your kingdom purpose.

Declare: I will stand unshaken, trusting His ever‑present strength.  

What moment today has you feeling God’s grace in action?
